title: Liquid Platinum object icons
description: Geometry for the object-icon tier. No colours: lighting comes from the `object` group in tokens/tokens.json.

finish.description: 'glossy' lays Aqua's sweep over the lit passes. Application icons only.

silhouette.description: The id of the part that casts the contact shadow and carries the outer keyline.

glyph.description: The icons.json glyph this falls back to below object.tier-glyph-max. Omit when a glyph of the same name exists.

facet.description: Which way the surface faces the key light. This is what turns geometry into lighting without any per-icon gradient.

tone.description: A signed lighting offset in object.tone-step units — screened when positive, multiplied when negative. Not a colour.

role.description: body (default) fills; crease strokes the 1px emboss pair; mark is a glyph-tier stroke drawn on top.

material.description: Overrides the icon's material for this part.

tint.description: A dotted tokens.json path — a flat fill instead of the material ramp, for small non-material details.

min.description: Drop this part below this rendered size.
